conclusion: Same static arrangement, 12 separately captured frames: no observed loss of existing front-robot proposals. Baseline already produced no cone proposal, so this sequence does NOT demonstrate 12-frame cone false-positive removal. It also does not demonstrate full-base boxes, stable center correction, cross-scene generalization or moving obstacle avoidance.
description: Held-out 12 captured RGB-D frames of the same static arrangement. Algorithm was frozen before evaluation. ROI labels reviewed independently from the 12-frame contact sheet; not cross-scene accuracy.
raw_data_policy: The full RGB-D sequence and per-frame diagnostics remain local under .tools/field-follow-fix. Only this non-image provenance summary is retained; the separately captured development-frame depth crop is the portable regression fixture.
